segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Arelma and the Swiss accounts, they were the subject of summary judgments po ng Sandiganbayan.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: So, na-recover na ho iyan.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: And then, as to the other assets po, they became the subject of compromise agreements,

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: whereby these assets were surrendered to the government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Surrendered by whom?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Surrendered po.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Iyong mga, those who were, uh, perhaps standing as dummies, they surrendered the, the assets po.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: So, marami na po tayong recoveries diyan.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: And some of these properties were recovered in other cases po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Some but not all.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Well, there are still assets, but, uh, when we investigated po, ano eh, wala na po talagang—for example po, there were corporations listed in that case.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: But then, these corporations turned out to be unregistered or non-operational na po,

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: and then we don't have anymore the witnesses.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: So, we had to be candid with the court, uh, by stating that we are no longer presenting evidence po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, so, Chair, maaari po bang makahingi sa PCGG ng parang pinaka-report on, uh, the recovered hidden wealth,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ah, especially, ah, iyong mga pinakahuli na nabanggit ninyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At mayroon ba tayong imbentaryo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano ba talaga iyong buong tina-target natin?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Opo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ano iyong na-recover na natin at ano iyong hindi pa natin nare-recover?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Mayroon po tayong imbentaryo niyan.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Uh, mayroon din tayong imbentaryo ng current cases po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Ah, about, uh, 67 cases po iyan which are pending in the appellate courts.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Ang halaga po niyan,

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: mga more than 70

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: billion pa ho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: More than ₱70 billion?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Oo.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Ang abogado po namin eh ang OSG po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ₱70 billion pa ang tina-target natin na mabawi na ill-gotten wealth ng pamilyang Marcos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama po?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Opo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ang PCGG po ay, ah, ano po ba kayo? Attached agency to the—

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Attached agency po kami sa Department of Justice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kayo po, appointee po kayo?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Opo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sino ang nag-appoint sa inyo?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Si President Marcos po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Si President Marcos din.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, well, just your—gusto ko lang po marinig:

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi po ba awkward sa inyo?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Awkward po, pero trabaho po iyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: But then, to the credit of the President

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: and the family,

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: we never, uh, uh, were pressured on anything po.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: We have been performing our duty independently.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: So, wala pong undue influence on us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, well, so, ang malinaw po, may tina-target pa kayo na ₱70 billion worth of ill-gotten wealth.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Opo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, at may mga pending cases ang mga iyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Opo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kaya narito kayo ngayon para humingi ng budget para matuloy ninyo pa iyong laban na iyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Tama po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At, ah, kasi noon, may mga proposal po na i-abolish na raw ang PCGG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tapos na raw ang, ang, you know, ang mandato ninyo o wala nang mare-recover.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sumasang-ayon ba kayo doon?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Ah, kami po eh sang-ayon na ma-abolish iyong PCGG,

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: but in its place, mayroon po sanang maitatayong new agency that will take over the mandate of the PCGG, but expanded mandate po.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Kasi ang mandate po ngayon ng PCGG is napaka-limited po eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: It's just the Marcos ill-gotten wealth.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Tama po.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Uh, but then, we want it to be expanded so that, uh, the mandate will be applied to all public officials who have unlawfully acquired assets.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, so, halimbawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ibig ninyong sabihin iyong mga tipong flood control, ganoon?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Opo.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Ang, ang puwede pong gawin diyan is just to file civil forfeiture cases under RA 1379 po.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Kasi under that law eh nakalagay po doon na any public official who has assets that are manifestly out of proportion to his salary and other legitimate sources of income,

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: there is already a presumption po na ill-gotten iyan.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: And so, the burden of proof shifts to the public official to explain how he was able to amass so much assets, given na this is only salary.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Kaya nga po mapapansin ninyo, iyong, iyong decision po ng Sandiganbayan doon sa Swiss accounts po tsaka Arelma, summary judgment po iyon.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: In other words, it's just based on the pleadings.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Mahirap ho kasi ang criminal case

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: kasi, ang unang-una po, ang quantum of evidence

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: is proof beyond reasonable doubt,

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: and you have to establish iyong, iyong paper trail to show na iyong asset na iyan came from government funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Could you just explain further ano iyong ibig sabihin ng summary judgment?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Opo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: By foreign courts?

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Dito po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: By local courts.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Sandiganbayan po ang nag-render ng summary judgment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, okay.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Iyong pong isang summary judgment na iyan, opo, kasama iyong Arelma.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Ah, the Philippine government filed a petition for forfeiture—ay, for enforcement of foreign judgment po sa New York.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Eh nanalo po tayo diyan.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: There was an appeal.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: Recently eh lumabas na po iyong decision.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: We won the appeal po.

segments.speaker: PCGG Chairperson Melchor Quirino C. Sadang
segments.text: So, we are just waiting for the action of the U.S. Supreme Court if they will still, uh, affirm the decision of the Court of Appeals po ng, ano, ng New York.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Well, Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, nagpapasalamat po ako sa chair ng PCGG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: We, we look forward doon sa report, no, iyong kabuuang summary ng mga efforts na ginagawa ng komisyon para ituloy ang laban para bawiin ang ill-gotten wealth ng pamilyang Marcos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ang sinasabi po rito, may ₱70 billion pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ₱70 billion na kailangang bawiin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, we look forward to that report, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Thank you, po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Thank you, po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ah, Cong. Tony Tinio?

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: May we recognize Chair Mika Suansing for her manifestation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Vice Chair Mike.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you for presiding over today's deliberation on the budget of the Department of Justice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Iniwan ko po kayo, Sec, kay Vice Chair Mike Tan because you're in very...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: You're in very good hands with him and he did so well today in facilitating all the discussions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you so much, Vice Chair Mike Tan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, I just wanted to, po, wrap up essentially everything that was discussed today.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I think it all boils down to the budgetary requirements of the DOJ.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I was looking through your slides, Sec, and very clear naman that in terms of MOOE, in terms of capital outlay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: ang laki ng binagsak ng budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: ng DOJ.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I'm looking at the agency-wise allocations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The one that stands out to me is Bureau of Immigration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Malaki po talaga yung nawala sa Bureau of Immigration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: It's not just the capital outlay, the locally funded project, kasi yun po yata yung ICT.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: But even the GASS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Malaki talaga yung binagsak.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: May I know, po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Which...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Specific components of the GASS were reduced.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: May I have a better idea of what we would need to restore, if ever?

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Yes, po, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Magandang gabi po, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Yung pong sa maintenance and other operating expenses, or MOOE, tinanggalan po kami ng 673,476,000.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ito po ang breakdown nun.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Additional provision for a drug-free workplace initiative.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: In the amount of...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Additional MOOE for EXPATS.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Yan po yung aming expanded alien registration system.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Umiikot po yung mga tao po namin sa buong Pilipinas para mag-alien mapping.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Tinanggalan po kami ng budget para doon ng 18,871,000.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: And then, yun din pong MOOE for locally funded projects for the development, enhancement, and procurement of IT systems and infrastructures.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang amount po niyan is 651,202,000.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Pagdating naman po, Your Honor, sa capital outlay, tinanggalan rin po kami ng 1,227,811,000.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Representing yung pong capital outlay for locally funded projects for the development, enhancement, and procurement of IT systems and infrastructures.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Yan po yung sa aming main office and sa support offices po namin over the Philippines.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang amount po diyan na tinanggal is 951,531,000.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: And last po, tinanggalan din po kami para sa post-construction ng aming bagong BI building in the amount of 276,280,000.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Dati po kasi ma'am, hindi po namin ma-request ito kasi ang sabi po ng DBM, hindi pa po kami nakakalipat sa building.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ngayon po, nakalipat na po kami recently.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: So, pero po kailangan po namin ng additional funding

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Para po sa post-construction, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Kom, I'd have to coordinate with you po because, like for example, just the Bureau of Immigration alone, that's a very substantive amount that would need to be restored if ever.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, given the limited fiscal space, we'd really have to prioritize which items we would need.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, in the Bureau of Immigration...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: In the Bureau of Immigration alone, we're looking at over 1.1, 1.2 billion, kasi nabanggit niyo po, IT system pa lang, 1 plus billion na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, siguro po, Kom, with SEC, kasi it's going to be one, essentially one list coming from DOJ.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, when Sec gives the list to me for items for consideration,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: ipa-prioritize na natin siya, Sec, among the different attached agencies within the DOJ.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, we'll have to look through that later on.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We'll gladly submit that wish list with the corresponding order of prioritization.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: And we will do the proper consultation with the various agencies here.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Kasi usually po, di ba, I really ask for the help of the head of the agency to essentially rationalize all the requests from the different agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, thank you, Kom, for enlightening us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Actually, as I was looking through the NEP, like, stand out sa akin yung over 1 billion reduction sa Bureau of Immigration alone.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And then now that I'm looking through the presentation of the Department of Justice as a whole,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: mas nakita ko na it's not just one agency that experienced that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: It's actually across the board.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, next po, we have...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Sorry, po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Medyo himayin ko lang siya, so I know where to focus.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Under the law enforcement program, siguro po, dito ako nagulat because a lot of the items that are considered priorities at the moment received a substantial cut.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: For example po, anti-trafficking in persons enforcement, that got a 41% decrease.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And ito talagang nagulat ako because this is a LEDAC measure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We even amended the OSAEC law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: OSAEC got a 59% decrease.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, yun po siguro, i-consider natin siguro, Sek, yun.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We will put them in the priority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: What else?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: For the corrections program, over half cut from the victims' compensation services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: For the NBI?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Director Melvin, nakita ko yung sa NBI, yung cut.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Sobrang laki din po for general administration support services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: 42% yung nawala po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, may you just enlighten me as to what items were cut within the GASS.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: There are six items na we want sana na ma-address yung mabalik, but there are a lot na tanggal.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Yung isa po, number one, yung priority ko is sana we increase the hazard pay

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: of our agents, only the agents, from 4,000 to 15,000.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Medyo hindi na po kami at par with other law enforcement.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: So, we've been transferring agents from one province to another, and it's very difficult

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: for them to cope up with the transfer.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: So, nahihirapan po kami na mag-ikot.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Number two, we are doing now an operation, so about 200 to 220 average operations per month.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Ito po yung mga kasama.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Kasama na po diyan yung mga [unclear].

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Lahat na po, financial scams, cybercrimes, and everything.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: So, right now, we are...

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Right now, we are asking for the increase; we're spending so much for the COPLAN.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: If you will just—yung pong COPLAN na tinatawag—when we do the operations,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: nandoon po lahat yung data na kailangan, including the expenses.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Normally, we are averaging the expenses nasa minimum 100.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: So if you put to 100 po yung sa co-plan namin, averaging at 200 to 220,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: mga 44 billion a month na po yung kailangan namin dyan to continue what we've been doing.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: At meron po kaming upgrade sana ng equipment, yung pong sa mga drones na kailangan namin bilhin,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: and other issues that we want to address in order for us also to address yung administrative capability namin.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: We want to do yung pong ISO namin, gusto rin namin sanang gawin doon.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: And another is purchase of additional vehicles,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: which is very critical in our operations.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: A lot of our vehicles right now are marked or red plate po.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: So we cannot do the operations using the marked vehicles,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: kasi darating pa lang po kami, sasabihin, ‘Andiyan yung mga NBI, may gagawin.’

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: So those are the things po na kinat po sa amin, medyo marami po talaga.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: We recognize yung sa budget utilization on the previous year,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: and we have plugged it down, and if we look at the mandate given by the Congress,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: na nag-expand po yung aming

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: investigative power,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: which we have to cope up, especially in the issues po of cybercrime.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: About 8 out of 10 crimes, related na po yung cyber, 80%.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: So yan po yung isa namin gusto sanang ma-address.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Right now, we are sharing the tools that CICC have,

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: pero sana po meron din kami capability.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: So siguro may mga Congs po na very concerned in their district to address also those crimes.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: We are looking forward to put up cybercrime laboratories sana sa mga regions.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: And those things po, those are all law enforcement tools and equipment that we need

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: para po medyo makahabol.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Kasama na po dyan yung issue ng shooting sa Ateneo de Zamboanga and also sa Tacloban.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Meron po kaming mga continuous monitoring that we need the support po of the Committee on Appropriations

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: to address these concerns po.

segments.speaker: NBI Director Melvin Matibag
segments.text: Salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Director Melvin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Actually, you were talking about anti-cybercrime.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And nakita ko, hindi ko pa lang po nabanggit kanina,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: aside from anti-trafficking in persons enforcement and OSAEC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: yung anti-cybercrime pala sobrang laki ng binagsak, 71%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Across the board, looking at the corrections program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: half from the victims' compensation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: looking at the legal services program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: 15% from the...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: refugee and stateless persons protection unit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Sa BuCor, natanggalan din po sa GASS, 13%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Sa immigration, we've discussed that already.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: LRA, nabawasan din yung GASS by 12%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: OGCC, nabawasan din yung GASS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So across the board talaga yung general administration and support services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And then for OSG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: operations got cut by 8%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: PPA, 36% din sa GASS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And PCGG, 64%, less RLIP and special account.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So across the board,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: it's very helpful that you were able to segment it in this manner,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: kasi at least nakikita namin na each agency talaga,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: even OADR, GASS din and operations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So we're able to see the cuts across the board within the DOJ.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So SEC, we'll work together po with Vice Chair Mike Tan

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: in terms of prioritizing the items for consideration in restoration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Because as you know po, here in the Committee on Appropriations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: one of the important reforms that we've done

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: was we now have the Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: which deliberates on,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and discusses line by line,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: all the amendments that we would incorporate into the GAB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And those amendments po would come from the request,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: the institutional amendments request emanating from the agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So hihingi po sana kami ng tulong ninyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: all the heads of agencies and all of our officials po in the DOJ,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: please help us po, please guide us,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: so that,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: when we do prioritize items for restoration,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: at least po, it's in line with the priorities of the agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Sayang naman po kung malagyan namin ng pondo yung isang bagay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: na hindi naman talaga yun yung priority ng ahensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So in this, in this, ano po, in this process,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: let's partner po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So we would best allocate and optimize the utilization of resources,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: given our very limited fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So SEC, sorry po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Magse-set lang ako ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: kung kaya po sana,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: if you can send us within the week,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: best po if you can send it ASAP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: just so we're able to consolidate everything before the deliberation of the BARC.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We will comply.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: We will comply and definitely submit a comprehensive listing

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: with the appropriate prioritization per agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And then I'll also defer to Vice Chair Mike,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: if in case there's like back and forth before we finalize the prioritized list.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yun lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I think yun po, that's the most important,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: my most important role in this hearing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: which is to make sure that we're able to best identify the items that would require restoration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So on our part po, best effort.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: But again, we all recognize that we have limited fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: But we'll make sure po that we're able to allocate resources in the most optimized manner.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you SEC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you to the officials po of the DOJ. Ay, sorry po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And lastly po, lastly po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: we recognize the great work that the DOJ and all the attached agencies have been doing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: especially from the law enforcement side.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And ano po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: we want to recognize that by also equipping you

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: with the resources that you need

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: to be able to perform your mandates better.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So we're your partners po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Alam niyo naman po 'yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We're always in support of all the projects and programs that you are,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and all the good that you are doing for our country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So I just wanted to take this opportunity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Maraming maraming salamat po for all the great work that you're doing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Thank you, Chair Mika.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Uh, may we solicit a motion to terminate

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: the budget briefing of the DOJ and its attached agencies?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: Madam Chair, I move to terminate today's—

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: I move that we suspend the committee proceedings

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: and resume tomorrow, August 25, 2026 at 9 a.m.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ann Matibag
segments.text: So I so move, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Ah, there is a motion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: Duly seconded.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: The— for the Andaya Hall,

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: the committee proceedings are now suspended

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: and will resume tomorrow, August 25, 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Keith Micah "Atty. Mike" D.L. Tan
segments.text: at 9 a.m.
